roles.heading: Delivery leadership across the whole program, not just the team.
items: Senior and Principal Delivery or Program Management

experience.heading: Seventeen years of getting hard things shipped.

jobs.company: State of Colorado, Governor’s Office of Information Technology
jobs.title: Senior Scrum Master, contractor
jobs.summary: Led Agile delivery for statewide Identity and Access Management across state and county agencies, technical teams and NTT DATA.
bullets: Coordinated about 18 IAM production releases, sustaining the Product Owner’s 6 to 8 week cadence.
Built sprint pre-planning, story readiness and SME review. Earlier discovery of agency configurations eliminated corrective interim releases.
Ran security, audit and Splunk logging remediation as scope grew from 179 to nearly 6,000 servers.

jobs.title: Senior Scrum Master, contractor
jobs.summary: Customer account management web and mobile apps, focused on customer experience, service efficiency and cost savings.
bullets: Raised team velocity 16% and Agile team maturity 11% through coaching and continuous improvement.
Led the integration with a paperless billing vendor to cut costs.
Advocated for accessibility so users of all abilities could reach their goals.

jobs.title: Senior Scrum Master
jobs.summary: Scrum Master for the Employee Ordering App, which grew from $259M to over $2B in annual revenue within its first three years.
bullets: Built trust and psychological safety across cross-functional stakeholders.
Reported delivery metrics to leadership through a digital transformation.
Reinvented retrospectives across multiple teams to keep them improving.

jobs.title: Senior Scrum Master, Senior Project Manager, Program Manager
jobs.summary: Twelve years leading delivery on a high availability payments platform: processor integrations, card brand mandates, security and production support.
bullets: Coordinated 10 to 12 production releases a month and more than 100 initiatives across distributed teams.
Led frontend processor integrations saving about $13M a year and backend settlement integrations saving about $3M a year.
Introduced a five week PI Planning prep approach and coached multiple Release Train Engineers. Offered the formal RTE role.
Took part in cryptographic key ceremonies for secure debit key administration.

items.title: Find the risk before it finds us
items.body: Pre-planning, story readiness and SME review bring requirements and dependencies into the open while they’re still cheap to fix.

items.title: Every voice in the room
items.body: Psychological safety isn’t soft. It’s how a team hears about the problem in week two instead of release night.

items.title: Escalate with care
items.body: Clear executive updates, honest risk calls and priorities aligned before they collide. No surprises upstairs.

items.title: Coach the coaches
items.body: I coach Scrum Masters, Product Owners and Release Train Engineers, and leave reusable practices behind so the team keeps going after I step back.

items.quote: Robin is the person who makes a hard program feel calm. She gets agencies, vendors and engineers talking early, and she makes sure every voice is heard. I’d work with her again in a heartbeat.
items.name: Phil Morehead

credentials.certifications_note: Scrum Alliance certifications current through April 2028. Leading SAFe 4.0, SAFe 4.5 Agilist and SAFe Advanced Scrum Master 4.5 held previously.
